audit_events_actor_shape_check.name: audit_events_actor_shape_check
audit_events_actor_shape_check.value: (actor_type = 'team_user' AND client_actor_id IS NULL) OR (actor_type = 'client_user' AND actor_id IS NULL) OR (actor_type = 'anonymous_session' AND actor_id IS NULL AND client_actor_id IS NULL)

presentation_approvals_decided_shape_che.name: presentation_approvals_decided_shape_check
presentation_approvals_decided_shape_che.value: (status IN ('requested', 'withdrawn') AND decided_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('granted', 'declined') AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)

presentation_approvals_decline_reason_ch.name: presentation_approvals_decline_reason_check
presentation_approvals_decline_reason_ch.value: (status = 'declined' AND decline_reason IS NOT NULL AND char_length(decline_reason) BETWEEN 3 AND 2000) OR (status <> 'declined' AND decline_reason IS NULL)

presentation_items_shape_check.name: presentation_items_shape_check
presentation_items_shape_check.value: (kind = 'file' AND file_id IS NOT NULL AND body IS NULL) OR (kind = 'note' AND file_id IS NULL AND body IS NOT NULL)

presentation_reviews_response_shape_chec.name: presentation_reviews_response_shape_check
presentation_reviews_response_shape_chec.value: (response_body IS NULL AND responded_at IS NULL) OR (response_body IS NOT NULL AND responded_at IS NOT NULL)

presentation_revision_items_shape_check.name: presentation_revision_items_shape_check
presentation_revision_items_shape_check.value: (kind = 'file' AND file_id IS NOT NULL AND body IS NULL AND display_name_snapshot IS NOT NULL) OR (kind = 'note' AND file_id IS NULL AND body IS NOT NULL AND display_name_snapshot IS NULL)

presentations_published_shape_check.name: presentations_published_shape_check
presentations_published_shape_check.value: (status = 'published' AND current_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'published')

workroom_files_ready_shape_check.name: workroom_files_ready_shape_check
workroom_files_ready_shape_check.value: (status = 'pending' AND byte_size IS NULL AND storage_etag IS NULL) OR (status = 'ready' AND byte_size IS NOT NULL AND storage_etag IS NOT NULL)

workroom_files_byte_size_check.name: workroom_files_byte_size_check
workroom_files_byte_size_check.value: byte_size IS NULL OR (byte_size > 0 AND byte_size <= 2147483648)

workroom_files_shared_shape_check.name: workroom_files_shared_shape_check
workroom_files_shared_shape_check.value: (visibility = 'internal' AND shared_at IS NULL) OR (visibility = 'shared' AND shared_at IS NOT NULL AND status = 'ready')

workroom_files_key_shape_check.name: workroom_files_key_shape_check
workroom_files_key_shape_check.value: (status = 'pending' AND storage_key LIKE 'pending/%') OR (status = 'ready' AND storage_key LIKE 'w/%')
